nodes.name: Medium contract
nodes.relation_to_prior: Canonical re-cut of N101. Positions 2–5 survive in name; position 1 re-worded into two realisations (offer / notice) because N101's 'ask licence' presumed the offer variant and the corpus's own English flows never ask; role-neutrality made explicit; gloss kept verbatim.
nodes.role_neutral_note: In the health corpus the professional is the learner and the patient is the native; in the Bologna instantiation the learner is the customer. Nothing in the positions depends on who serves whom — either party may be the declarer.
nodes.gloss: One party declares a limitation on the medium of the encounter itself and pre-negotiates the repair protocol BEFORE any business starts. The licence is issued in advance of the trouble it covers.

positions.name: declare own limitation on the medium

realisations.offer: a shared alternative medium exists: propose conducting the encounter in the weaker medium, name the fallback, ask — 'I'm learning X… if we get stuck I might ask you to speak Y, if that's okay'. Only the offer can be declined.
realisations.notice: no alternative medium exists: the declaration and the repair licence fuse into one turn — 'X isn't my first language, so if anything isn't clear, just tell me'. Nothing to accept or decline.

positions.name: grant + reassure
positions.branches: declined (S1201), diverted into biography (S1202), participant admission (C1203)

positions.name: issue the standing repair licence
positions.note: at full strength mutual ('and I'll do the same if I don't follow you') and pre-disarmed ('I won't be offended', 'it's never a silly question'); fuses into position 1 in the notice realisation

stripped_as_pair_and_culture: the institutional fallback ('call someone who speaks Welsh more confidently') — sector/culture: language provision as infrastructure
the applause economy ('Chwarae teg i chi', 'Fair play') — Wales rewarding the offer as a civic act
the stakes-raiser ('it's really important that you understand everything') — health's duty-of-care register, sector-conditional; re-manufactured by any high-stakes span in any sector
the offence-disclaimer form of the face-repair tail ('no offence meant' / 'none taken at all') — cultural form around the canonical de-personalising function
the native's stake in the learner's project (the grandson learning in school) — the shared-cause warmth economy of a minority language
nodes.quote: "I'm learning Welsh at the moment, so I'll try to stay in Welsh as much as possible, but if we get stuck I might need to ask you to speak English, if that's okay." (1.0 Welsh flow 1) / "English isn't my first language, so if you have any trouble understanding me, just let me know and I'll explain myself more clearly" (1.0 English flow 1) — same shape, different admission; the second realisation never asks.
nodes.why_not_an_existing_node: N6 Repair is the trouble handled when it arrives; N1201 is the licence granted before it arrives, and the two are different positions in time. N9 Feasibility request asks whether the world permits X; N1201 declares that the SPEAKER may fail. Nothing in the ratified 29 negotiates the medium of the encounter. (Inherited from N101, checked against the ratified store at f4198e22f: still true.)
nodes.smoke_test: Passed in writing: the Bologna instantiation (document §6) — ita_for_eng, learner as customer in a pharmacy — instantiates every position and both attested branches with none of Wales's history, at three named costs, all pair-and-culture.
nodes.core_siting: CORE by Tom's ruling of 2026-08-31. Placement: a prologue — scene 0, after N1's open, before the first transaction ('Before we start -', 2.0 Welsh flow 1; §1.0 precedes even §1.1 Names). Prepending does not reorder CORE's existing scenes, so the audit's constraint holds; the set grows 18 → 19, which the ruling entails. Decline branch attaches at position 2 of scene 0 in the recovery-attachment mechanics. Every sector pod re-instantiates the contract in the pair's and sector's own terms as its opening (Tom's standing ruling for sector authoring); the every-optional-walk floor is untouched.

survivability.relation_to_prior: canonical re-cut of S1101, absorbing both attested account-types; S1101 remains defined in health-candidates-2026-08-31.json
survivability.b_attemptable_only_if: Offering to hold the encounter in the weaker medium (N1201 position 1, offer realisation)
survivability.a_survivable: The medium offer declined — the other party opts out of the offered medium
attested_response_positions: 1.0 Welsh flow 3 — 'Actually, I'd rather stick to English today if that's alright, love. I'm not feeling up to it.' → 'Of course, no problem at all. English it is. Let's get you sorted.' → 'Thank you, love. No offence meant - I'm just tired today.' → 'None taken at all.'

2.0 Welsh flow 2 — 'To be honest, doctor, with something medical I'd feel safer in English. I want to be sure I follow everything.' → 'That's completely sensible, and exactly the right instinct. English it is - clarity matters most here.' → 'No offence to your Welsh, now.' → 'None taken at all - you've done me a favour.'
survivability.recovery_note: Complete both times, four moves: yield instantly (no relitigating, no second offer), ratify the choice as sensible, de-personalise the refusal, re-anchor rapport and pivot. The ACCOUNT is a slot with two attested types — capacity ('not feeling up to it'), scoped to today, an implicit licence to re-offer next time; and stakes ('with something medical'), scoped to a domain, an implicit licence to keep the medium outside that domain. The offence-disclaimer tail is cultural form (Wales's politics of declining Welsh in a Welsh institution); the de-personalising function is canonical and survives in Bologna as the account itself plus warm ratification.

survivability.b_attemptable_only_if: Declaring a limitation on the medium (N1201 position 1, either realisation)
survivability.a_survivable: The offer diverted into biography — the declaration is met with neither grant nor decline but with a personal question about the declarer's own story; acceptance of the medium happens silently, by conduct
attested_response_positions: 1.0 Welsh flow 2 — 'Where are you learning, then? Are you doing the classes?' → biography answered → 'That's lovely to hear. Right, shall we make a start? Just stop me if I lose you.'
1.0 English flow 2 — 'Where are you from, if you don't mind me asking?' → biography answered → 'The weather takes some getting used to! But the people are kind. Now then, let's have a look at you.'
survivability.recovery_note: Complete both times, same recovery: answer the biography warmly, then SELF-INITIATE the pivot — the diversion never returns you to business; the learner must take themself back, and (first attestation) the repair licence gets issued on the way through. Attested once on each side of the offer/notice split, so the branch belongs to the declaration itself, not to the ask.
survivability.why_an_edge_not_just_composition: The interlude's turns are N5 mechanics (C1201 records that, as C109 recorded N7 inside the decline), but no composition captures what the learner must survive: a granted contract with no grant ever spoken, and a pivot nobody else will make. The learner who waits for 'of course, that's fine' before proceeding waits forever.

recorded_not_recommended.name: the busy decline (as a separate edge)
recorded_not_recommended.refusal: Same positions as S1201, different account — the account is a slot, not a shape. The calibration read already cited 1.0 Welsh flow 3 as an S1101 attestation; a separate mint would split one edge's own evidence in two.

recorded_not_recommended.name: the medium notice (as a second shape)
recorded_not_recommended.refusal: Same positions minus the ask — a realisation of N1201 position 1, not a shape. One shape with branches beats two shapes sharing four positions.

recorded_not_recommended.name: the participant admission (as a decline-family edge)
recorded_not_recommended.refusal: Composes as N9 at position 2 (C1203); a third party joining with everyone's knowledge is a branch of the contract's negotiation, not a threat to its premise.

gaps.name: the switch-back mid-conversation
gaps.evidence_of_absence: Swept all 73 flows; once an opener completes, no flow revisits the medium.
gaps.would_be_attested_by: A corpus whose stakes escalate mid-flow — the natural sites already exist in this corpus's safety-critical flows (1.4 flow 3, 1.5 flow 3), where a real professional would drop into the stronger medium for the critical span; a health v4 or any escalating sector corpus would attest it in six lines. May be scoped rather than total (the stakes account of S1201 already attests domain-scoping at the opener) — speculation until written down.

gaps.name: the third party who does not know you are learning
gaps.evidence_of_absence: The corpus's only third parties are announced helpers (C1203); the bedside cast is fixed at two plus family.
gaps.would_be_attested_by: Any corpus where a colleague, family member or second customer arrives mid-encounter unbriefed — a workplace or social corpus. Must stay distinct from the participant admission: the admission joins the contract, the stranger tests it.

gaps.name: the over-accommodation (the native slows to unnatural speech)
gaps.evidence_of_absence: No flow stages a native performing exaggerated slowness; the corpus's natives all respond naturally.
gaps.would_be_attested_by: Structurally the hardest: the trigger is paralinguistic — delivery, not lines — so a text corpus may never attest it cleanly. A text corpus CAN attest the recovery line ('you don't need to slow down — I'll stop you if I'm lost'); audio of real native-with-learner speech would attest the trigger directly. A decline in effect rather than in form; the family's best-known and least-evidenced member, off the list until a corpus writes it down.
